p.span:
$ARGUMENTS → N targets · discover.py
classify role: root / ancestor / child / local
→ (path, role, parentPath)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

p.span:
1 file → inline in main loop
2+ files → Workflow detect.js
fan-out = parallel(), one agent per file

div.style: color: rgb(226, 232, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FILE 1 · root
1 read root
2 load audit-criteria.md
3 apply CCP / CRP / ADP + Hygiene
4 schema-validate (if claude_md: block)
5 classify → taxonomy + bucket

div.style: color: rgb(226, 232, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FILE 2 · child
1 read child + parent CLAUDE.md
2 CCP cross-file dup-check → taxonomy B
3 apply CRP / ADP + Hygiene
4 schema-validate (if block)
5 classify → taxonomy + bucket

div.style: color: rgb(226, 232, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FILE N · local
1 read .local file
2 D-group criteria only
3 skip ADP / Hygiene
5 classify → taxonomy + bucket

div.style: color: rgb(148, 163, 184) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
… one lane per file
(N files total)

div.style: color: rgb(226, 232, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.span:
parallel() join · wait for every lane
compute bucket totals AUTO / DISCUSS / SPECIAL
main loop renders per-file report · the one sync point

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.span:
human-in-the-loop · interactive per DISCUSS / SPECIAL
inferred automatically when non-interactive ('fast')
AUTO findings auto-apply — no decision needed

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.span:
1 file → inline
2+ files → Workflow remediate.js
fan-out = parallel(), one lane per file (disjoint, no conflict)
